     entries.forEach(entry => {
         if (entry.isIntersecting) {
             showImageBackground(entry.target);
             imageObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
         }
     });
  }, backgroundOptions);    
  // observe each image
  lazyImages.forEach(image => {

  });

  }
});
</script>
